prompt: What can the man no longer read on the second label?
promptZh: 男子在第二罐的標籤上已看不到什麼資訊？

options.whyZh: 男子說看不清的是乾燥時間，不是漆色。

options.text: How long the paint takes to dry.
options.whyZh: 男子明說看不出乾燥時間。

options.text: Whether the paint dries shiny or flat.
options.zh: 漆乾後有光澤還是消光。

options.text: The place to bring unused paint.
options.whyZh: 第二罐的處理方式由女子決定，並非撕破標籤上的資訊。

explanationZh: 男子明說看不出乾燥時間。
evidence: The label on the second jar is damaged. A piece of it came off. I can still read the finish, but the drying time is missing.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The label on the second jar is damaged. A piece of it came off. I can still read the finish, but the drying time is missing.

vocabulary.note: 指漆需要多久才乾，不是可保留使用多久。
